io.name: a
io.description: Control input; when 1 holds q, when 0 increments q mod 8

functional_summary.overview: 3-bit up-counter with hold control. On each posedge, if a=1 q holds its value; if a=0 q increments by 1 modulo 8.
rules: On posedge clk: if a==1 then q <= q (hold); else q <= (q + 1) mod 8.
q is a 3-bit register initialized to 4 in the observed trace (initial value unspecified by contract; behavior defined from first sampled edge).
Output q updates one cycle after the sampled posedge (registered output).
